methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.UserFees: User pays fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees from paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: From 28 Dec 2025, a portion of fees a collected to buy back and burn UNI on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, WC, Zora, XLayer, From 2 Jun 2026, on Polygon, BSC, Celo, From 27 Jul 2026, on Robinhood
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 28 Dec 2025, a portion of fees a collected to buy back and burn UNI on Ethereum, From 8 Mar 2026, on Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, WC, Zora, XLayer, From 2 Jun 2026, on Polygon, BSC, Celo, From 27 Jul 2026, on Robinhood
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees distributed to LPs post protocol fee collection
methodology.Volume: Swap volume, excluding wash trading: pools whose daily trades come from too few distinct addresses to be organic, unless every pool token is a core asset or CoinGecko-listed.

methodology.UserFees: Users pay the pool's swap fee on every trade, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana
methodology.Fees: Traders pay a swap fee set per pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana
methodology.Revenue: The share of each swap fee Sushi keeps rather than paying to liquidity providers - nothing on most pools, 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, and 50% on Katana
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Sushi keeps all of its fee share, collected into a Sushi-controlled treasury wallet on each chain
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Negligible (was 38% before Mid of October 2025). SUSHI stakers stopped receiving major part of swap fees in Mid of October 2025; so no part of the fee is counted as going to holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers keep the rest of the swap fee in the pools they fund

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps - 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, 50% on Katana.
Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps, collected into a Sushi-controlled treasury wallet on each chain.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fees retained by liquidity providers after protocol fees.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).
